slp_storyline.title: 1H / 30m / 15m SLP Storyline (Bias Continuation)
slp_storyline.question: Walk the SLP storyline for bias continuation.

checks.label: Validated current bias and momentum from 4H
Trade in support of bias and momentum
Valid MSS, CHOCH, BOS or double BOS
Valid pullback liquidity
Next 2–3 unmitigated POIs (origin as POI = high probability)

1M/5M confirmation (MSS > Pullback > Origin or Next POI)
Aggressive entry for ITW textbook validated order block structure

profit_protection.title: Profit Protection
profit_protection.question: How will you manage the trade? (With trend vs against trend determines the protection rule.)

checks.label: Best: don't protect at all — close when profit is enough
With trend: no breakeven until max profit > 80%
With trend: use nearest 1H or 4H reversal POI as TP
Against trend: start protection from 30–40%
Against trend: use nearest 30m or 15m reversal POI as TP
